item.title: Suspended In Space | Filmsupply Films
item.description:
Two skiers are suspended in space and time as the frozen winter scape of the Yukon Territory awakens their souls.

The film was made as a nationwide partnership to advocate the natural beauty of the Yukon. Thank you to our partners, Travel Yukon, Air North, HeliCat Canada, and Yukon Heliski. The film was captured in the territories of Taku River Tlingit First Nations (TRTFN), Carcross/Tagish First Nations (CTFN), and The Champagne and Aishihik First Nations (CAFN).
